answer: The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. By the basalt of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, weighted by independent path length, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. The island is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the delta.
